newsitem.title: USA: Neogen to buy Triple Crown.
newsitem.headline: Neogen to buy Triple Crown.

text.p: Neogen Corp said Wednesday it had signed a letter of intent to buy most of the assets of Triple Crown, a unit of W.J. Bartus Inc of Fort Pierce, Fla. Terms were not disclosed.
Triple Crown, which makes products for the professional equine market, is profitable and expects sales this year of $1.8 million. Sales in 1996 were up 50 percent over 1995.
Neogen said Triple Crown President William Bartus will continue to work with Neogen in "some capacity" once the transaction is completed.
Due dilligence on the letter is expected to be completed within 30 days, it said.

Neogen currently offers diagnostic test kits, vaccines and topical products to the professional horse industry. It plans to relocate the acquired assets to its professional equine group headquarters in Lexington, Ky. Fiscal 1997 sales at the Lexington division were $3.3 million.

"Adding Triple Crown to our professional equine group gives us the ability to substantially increase sales by offering more products to our existing customer base, " Neogen President James Herbert said in a statement.
